_phase: 3 - first-mover pairing (claude -p --model opus over usable_fresh x low-penetration life)
_method: Opus subprocess in non-git tempdir (R3); proposes 10 best pairs across 24x42 cross-product
_schema_note: capability-match must be genuine; why_no_one_done_it references BOTH technique freshness AND domain under-serving

candidates.life_domain: Varroa mite monitoring (alcohol wash / sugar roll) — Agriculture & animal husbandry
candidates.domain_problem: Deciding whether to treat a colony requires dislodging mites from a ~300-bee sample and hand-counting them against seasonal thresholds; the count is tedious, error-prone, and done by eye with no automated sensor.
candidates.first_application: Beekeeper photographs the sugar-roll/wash sieve (mites on a white tray) with a phone; Molmo2 is prompted to point at and enumerate every mite, returning per-point coordinates and a total count, which is divided by sample size to yield mites/100-bees against the treatment threshold. Pointing output also visually verifies each detection for the user.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: Molmo2's state-of-the-art point-driven counting/grounding only released 2026-01, far too recent to have diffused into apiary tooling, and varroa counting is a hand-craft inside a very-low-AI-penetration smallholder domain that no vision team has targeted.
candidates.feasibility_now: Needs only a phone camera and a white sampling tray (already standard equipment) plus the released Molmo2-4B/8B checkpoint running locally; counting small high-contrast objects is exactly the released model's grounding strength, so a light prompt or few-shot fine-tune on tray photos suffices — no new hardware.
candidates.verbatim_quote: The powdered sugar roll is currently the most common and quickest tool to monitor mites.
candidates.capability_match_strength: strong — point-and-count grounding is the precise operation the manual mite tally requires.
candidates.reasoning_trace: Varroa counting reduces exactly to localize-and-tally small objects on a contrasting background, which is Molmo2's headline capability. First-mover because the pointing model is months old and no one has applied object-grounding VLMs to the beekeeping treatment-decision loop.

candidates.life_domain: Tuvan throat singing / overtone singing technique — Art, music & performance craft
candidates.domain_problem: Throat singers produce a sustained drone plus a focused overtone simultaneously; teaching styles like khoomei/sygyt is done by ear with no tool that isolates a learner's overtone to give corrective feedback on vocal-tract shaping.
candidates.first_application: Learner sings into a mic; SAM-Audio uses temporal-span and text prompting to separate the recording into two stems — the fundamental drone and the reinforced overtone melody. The isolated overtone stem is pitch-tracked to show the student, in real time, which harmonic they are focusing and how steadily, turning an invisible skill into a visible feedback signal.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: SAM-Audio's general promptable source separation only shipped 2025-12, and overtone-singing pedagogy is a tiny, very-low-AI-penetration tradition that no separation researcher has used as a target — the two had not yet met.
candidates.feasibility_now: Requires only a microphone recording and the pip-installable SAM-Audio-large checkpoint; isolating a sound from a mixture given a span/text prompt is the released model's core function, and pitch extraction on the resulting stem is trivial today.
candidates.verbatim_quote: Khoomei is traditionally a softer sounding style, with the fundamental (or drone) usually in the low-mid to midrange of the singer's normal voice.
candidates.capability_match_strength: strong — overtone-from-drone is literally a two-source separation, SAM-Audio's exact task.
candidates.reasoning_trace: The core pedagogical obstacle is that the overtone is buried in the drone and cannot be observed; a promptable separator pulls it out. First-mover because the foundation model is brand new and overtone pedagogy is an unserved niche.

candidates.life_domain: Cheese affinage (ripeness judged by touch) — Food, cooking, fermentation, culinary craft
candidates.domain_problem: An affineur decides when a wheel is at peak maturity by fingertip pressure and instinct; there is no objective, non-destructive, per-wheel instrument that predicts optimal ripeness, so timing-to-market is by feel.
candidates.first_application: Cheap per-shelf sensors (temperature, humidity, and a low-cost VOC/gas array) log each wheel's ripening environment; a tiny Reverso model forecasts the forward maturity trajectory of the gas/rind signals and flags the predicted peak-ripeness window per wheel, giving the affineur a non-destructive readiness estimate to confirm by touch.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: Reverso's 0.2–2.6M-param zero-shot forecasters that rival giant models only appeared 2026-02, and cheese affinage is a very-low-AI-penetration tactile craft with no existing sensor pipeline for anyone to plug a forecaster into.
candidates.feasibility_now: Needs only inexpensive environmental + VOC sensors per shelf and the released Reverso-Small checkpoint, which is small enough to run on a per-cave microcontroller; zero-shot forecasting means useful trajectories without a large labeled ripeness dataset to start.
candidates.verbatim_quote: The skilled affineur will need to use their finely-tuned senses (alongside a grading iron) to ascertain the cheese's stage of maturity and make decisions as to whether the cheese is ready for market.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — ripening is a slow multivariate time series and forecasting the peak is the right framing, though VOC→sensory ripeness needs calibration.
candidates.reasoning_trace: Affinage timing is fundamentally a forecasting problem on cheap environmental/gas time series, and Reverso's tiny zero-shot models make per-wheel edge deployment affordable. First-mover because the model class is months old and no AI has entered the affinage cave.

candidates.technique: VETime (Vision Enhanced Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection)
candidates.life_domain: Mechanical watch regulation (horology) — Social life, ritual, customs & trade
candidates.domain_problem: Regulating a movement so it keeps time across positions requires a watchmaker to read timegrapher traces by feel and diagnose escapement/balance faults; diagnosing rate errors and prescribing adjustments remains an expert manual craft with little assistive intelligence.
candidates.first_application: A microphone or piezo captures the watch's tick acoustics into a beat-timing series; VETime runs zero-shot anomaly detection and window localization on the trace to flag and locate irregularities (beat error, sticking escapement, positional rate drift), pointing the watchmaker at which part of the cycle and which position is faulty before they adjust.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: VETime's zero-shot anomaly-localization backbone with released checkpoints only landed 2026-02, and amateur/independent horology regulation is a very-low-AI-penetration craft where timegrapher interpretation has never been paired with a modern anomaly model.
candidates.feasibility_now: A consumer timegrapher or contact mic already produces the signal; VETime's released checkpoints localize anomalies zero-shot, so no labeled fault corpus is required to begin, and inference is light enough for a benchtop laptop.
candidates.verbatim_quote: Mechanical watches are typically not as accurate as quartz watches, and they eventually require periodic cleaning, lubrication and calibration by a skilled watchmaker.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — timegrapher diagnosis is anomaly detection/localization on a periodic signal, which is VETime's exact zero-shot capability.
candidates.reasoning_trace: The unsolved part of regulation is interpreting the beat trace, which maps cleanly onto zero-shot time-series anomaly localization. First-mover because the backbone is brand new and benchtop horology has no AI diagnostic tooling.

candidates.life_domain: Inpainting / retouching in painting conservation — Art, music & performance craft
candidates.domain_problem: Filling losses so the fill blends with surrounding colours but covers no original paint, stays reversible, and matches aged varnish is an extremely slow, case-by-case hand process; generative inpainting exists for photos but is essentially unused for physical conservation decisions.
candidates.first_application: Conservator supplies a high-res photo plus a mask of the documented lacuna; InternVL-U's unified understanding+editing generates candidate in-loss fills strictly inside the mask, conditioned on surrounding palette and varnish tone, producing visualization proposals (and explicit edit maps) the conservator evaluates before any physical, reversible retouch — the model only paints the loss, never original areas.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: A single lightweight model that both understands the scene and does masked editing well only released 2026-03, and conservation inpainting is a very-low-AI-penetration field where generative tools were never adapted to the no-cover-original/reversibility constraints.
candidates.feasibility_now: Needs only existing conservation photographs and hand-drawn loss masks plus the released 4B HuggingFace checkpoint; mask-constrained editing is the model's native function, so it runs on a single workstation GPU as a decision-support visualizer (not an irreversible actuator).
candidates.verbatim_quote: Inpainting is the work done by a conservator-restorer to reinstate obliterated or damaged areas in a pictorial layer, in a way that blends with the surrounding colors but without covering any of the original paint.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — masked generative fill that respects surrounding context is the right tool, constrained to proposing visualizations rather than physical action.
candidates.reasoning_trace: Loss-filling is masked image editing conditioned on local color/varnish context, which is InternVL-U's unified edit capability, used as a planning aid. First-mover because the unified 4B model is weeks old and conservation has stayed outside generative tooling.

candidates.life_domain: Soy sauce / miso moromi maturity assessment — Food, cooking, fermentation, culinary craft
candidates.domain_problem: Maturity of the moromi mash over 6–18+ months is gauged by an experienced brewer's nose and eye; the literature explicitly notes there is no objective, fast, intuitive maturity metric.
candidates.first_application: In-tank probes log multivariate fermentation signals (pH, temperature, salinity, dissolved gases, VOC array) across months; Toto 2.0 forecasts the joint trajectory and, by modeling cross-channel interactions, projects the convergence point of the maturity-correlated variables, surfacing an objective predicted ready-window the brewer confirms by palate.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: Toto 2.0's multivariate forecasting foundation models with cross-domain transfer only released 2026-05, and miso/shoyu brewing is a very-low-AI-penetration craft whose own literature admits no objective maturity tool exists for a forecaster to fill.
candidates.feasibility_now: Requires standard food-grade tank probes plus a cheap VOC sensor and the released open-weights Toto checkpoints; its multivariate, long-context design fits month-scale fermentation logs directly, and zero-/few-shot transfer means a single brewery's history can bootstrap it.
candidates.verbatim_quote: there is currently a deficiency of an objective, fast, and intuitive evaluation method for maturity.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — moromi maturity is a long multivariate time series, and Toto's multivariate forecasting is the apt instrument, pending sensor-to-flavor calibration.
candidates.reasoning_trace: The brewer's gap is the absence of an objective maturity signal, which a multivariate forecaster over fermentation telemetry directly provides. First-mover because Toto 2.0 is the newest multivariate TS foundation model and the domain has explicitly documented the missing tool.

candidates.life_domain: Whistled language interpretation (Silbo Gomero) — Language & linguistics
candidates.domain_problem: Whistled registers compress a full spoken language into a few pitch/continuity contrasts and are decoded back to speech only by trained human ears in real time; there is no robust tool to transcribe or translate whistled speech, and it survives in a handful of communities.
candidates.first_application: Field recordings of whistled utterances feed Audio-Omni, whose frozen Qwen2.5-Omni MLLM + DiT stack is fine-tuned on paired whistle/Spanish examples to map whistle contours to a phoneme/word transcription and optional spoken-Spanish rendering, producing the first automatic whistle→text/speech pipeline for documentation and learning.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: An end-to-end audio MLLM unifying understanding and generation across general sound and speech only released 2026-04, and Silbo is a very-low-AI-penetration endangered register that no speech team has paired with such a model.
candidates.feasibility_now: Silbo has existing recorded corpora and Spanish parallels; the released Audio-Omni code+checkpoint provides the understanding backbone, so fine-tuning on a modest paired set is the only step — no new sensing required.
candidates.verbatim_quote: Silbo replaces each vowel or consonant with a whistling sound.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — a unified audio-understanding MLLM is the right backbone for whistle→text, given fine-tuning on the small parallel corpus.
candidates.reasoning_trace: Whistled-speech decoding is an audio-to-language understanding task, exactly what Audio-Omni's MLLM front-end targets. First-mover because the omni audio model is two months old and whistled languages are a nearly untouched documentation problem.

candidates.life_domain: Glassblowing (working glass at the right viscosity by eye) — Traditional craft & trades
candidates.domain_problem: A gaffer keeps molten glass in a narrow workable viscosity band by reading its color and feel and knowing when to reheat; it is kinesthetic memory with no instrument feeding the working state in real time.
candidates.first_application: A cheap thermal camera snapshots the glass gather's surface temperature field; SGNO, trained on the transient heat-conduction PDE for a cooling glass mass, rolls the temperature/viscosity field forward several seconds and signals when the workpiece will leave the workable band — i.e., 'reheat now' guidance derived from a physics surrogate rather than feel.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: SGNO's stable long-horizon autoregressive PDE rollouts only published 2026-02, and glassblowing is a very-low-AI-penetration kinesthetic craft where no one had cast the reheat decision as a real-time PDE-surrogate forecast.
candidates.feasibility_now: Needs a consumer thermal camera and an SGNO model fine-tuned on simulated/measured glass cooling (a well-characterized heat-conduction PDE), all runnable with the released 1D/2D/3D code; the physics is standard, so training data can be generated rather than collected.
candidates.verbatim_quote: The working temperature is reduced in the furnace to around 1,090 °C (2,000 °F), at which stage the glass appears to be a bright orange color.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — cooling-glass viscosity evolution is a heat-conduction PDE, and stable long-horizon rollout is SGNO's specialty.
candidates.reasoning_trace: The gaffer's unaided judgment is really forecasting a thermal/viscosity field, which a PDE neural operator can surrogate from a thermal snapshot. First-mover because SGNO is months old and no PDE-surrogate has been pointed at real-time hot-glass working.

candidates.life_domain: Ethnoveterinary medicine documentation and dosing — Medicine & health
candidates.domain_problem: Smallholders treat livestock with plant remedies where vets are unavailable, but suffer poor knowledge of application rates/dosage, inadequate diagnosis, and almost no documentation — an indigenous knowledge system with essentially no decision-support tooling.
candidates.first_application: A curated ethnoveterinary corpus (plant remedies, indications, dosage rates, cautions) is used to instruct-tune a 1.58-bit + N:M-sparse LLM that runs fully offline on a basic rural smartphone; the farmer describes symptoms and available plants, and the on-device model returns documented remedy options, dosing ranges, and warnings without any connectivity.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: Sparse-BitNet's combination of ternary quantization with structured sparsity for genuinely on-device LLMs only released 2026-03, and ethnoveterinary practice is a very-low-AI-penetration field with no decision-support tools — and offline edge deployment is the binding constraint that older models couldn't meet.
candidates.feasibility_now: Needs an assembled ethnoveterinary text corpus (ethnobotanical surveys exist) and the released train/eval/generate scripts; extreme quantization + sparsity is precisely what makes an offline phone advisor feasible in no-connectivity regions today.
candidates.verbatim_quote: Some farmers have failed to use ethnoveterinary medicine due to poor knowledge of application rates (dosage), inadequate diagnosis, lack of documentation and side effects of the concoctions.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — the decisive requirement is offline on-device inference in low-connectivity areas, which is exactly Sparse-BitNet's contribution.
candidates.reasoning_trace: The documented failure is missing offline dosing/diagnosis support where vets and networks are absent, so the binding constraint is edge deployability, which Sparse-BitNet uniquely enables among fresh models. First-mover because the framework is months old and the domain has no decision-support tooling at all.

candidates.life_domain: Polynesian wayfinding (star compass & wave piloting) — Navigation, wayfinding & orientation
candidates.domain_problem: Traditional navigators hold course across open ocean with no instruments, integrating a memorized 32-house star compass and swell patterns entirely in the head; the knowledge is oral, hard to teach, and has no computational model.
candidates.first_application: Sequential cues — star bearings from a sky camera, IMU heading, and swell/period from a motion buoy — stream into a Mamba-3 model trained to integrate them into a continuously updated heading/position estimate, producing the first computational dead-reckoning model of the star-compass-plus-swell method, usable as a teaching simulator and an instrument-free orientation aid.
candidates.why_no_one_done_it: Mamba-3's more expressive recurrence and complex-valued state updates for richer state tracking only published 2026-03, and traditional wayfinding has zero AI penetration ('none'), so no one had cast the navigator's mental integration as a learned state-space model.
candidates.feasibility_now: Needs only a sky-facing camera, an IMU, and a wave-motion sensor (all cheap) plus the released Mamba code; dead-reckoning is sequential state integration, the native strength of a state-space model, and training data can be generated from voyaging simulators or logged sails.
candidates.verbatim_quote: The star compass is a mental construct and not physical like a western compass.
candidates.capability_match_strength: medium — instrument-free dead reckoning is sequential state integration, which is precisely what an expressive SSM models.
candidates.reasoning_trace: The navigator's skill is continuous state estimation from noisy sequential cues, mapping naturally onto Mamba-3's improved state tracking, giving the field its first computational model. First-mover because the architecture is months old and wayfinding has no AI work whatsoever.
